name: Elder
about: Knows what is out there and would rather you dealt with it, leaning on a staff older than the village itself.
greetings: You are not from the valley.
We have a problem, and you have a weapon.
gossip: There is a thing in the deep places that was here before the village.
The old road east is not safe and has not been for a generation.
Every dungeon has ten floors and something at the bottom of them. Every single one.
